test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In March 2022, the Karnataka government announced Vijay Samarasya Yojana, an awareness programme to eradicate __________ in gram panchayats across the state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Untouchability**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vijay Samarasya Yojana is specifically designed to eradicate **untouchability** in gram panchayats across Karnataka.
 
• The Karnataka government announced this awareness programme in March 2022.
 
• Untouchability is a social evil that has been prevalent in India for centuries, and this scheme aims to address and eliminate this discrimination at the grassroots level.
 
• The programme involves various awareness campaigns and activities to promote social harmony and equality among different communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Untouchability**

 
 
• Untouchability is a deeply rooted social practice in India that ostracizes a particular group of people, primarily Dalits, who are deemed "impure" by caste-based society.
 
• Despite being legally abolished by the Indian Constitution under Article 17, untouchability still exists in various forms across the country.
 
• Various government schemes and initiatives aim to eradicate this practice and promote social equality and justice.
 
• Awareness programs like Vijay Samarasya Yojana play a crucial role in changing societal attitudes and behaviors towards marginalized communities.
 
 
 
• **Gram Panchayat**
 
 
• A Gram Panchayat is the basic unit of local self-government in India's rural areas, functioning at the village or small town level.
 
• It comprises elected members and is responsible for the administration and development of the village, including implementing government schemes.
 
• The Gram Panchayat plays a crucial role in grassroots democracy and governance, ensuring that the needs and issues of rural populations are addressed.
 
 
 
• **Social Harmony**
 
 
• Social harmony refers to the peaceful and respectful coexistence of different social groups within a community or society.
 
• Promoting social harmony involves addressing and eliminating social prejudices, discrimination, and conflicts to create a more inclusive and equitable society.
 
• Government initiatives and awareness programs are essential tools in fostering social harmony, especially in diverse and multicultural societies like India.
